newsitem.title: FINLAND: Lemminkainen up on fresh sector interest.
newsitem.headline: Lemminkainen up on fresh sector interest.

text.p: Shares in Finnish construction group Lemminkainen Oy jumped in fair trade on Thursday as investors found the construction sector which remained out of focus in February, brokers said.

At 1635/1435 GMT, Lemminkainen traded at 57.00 markka, up 3.00 markka or more than five percent, after hitting a 57.90 calendar year-high. Trade amounted to 2.6 million markka, which is fair for Lemminkainen.

"Investors have found construction stocks, and no wonder, the sector has bottomed out and better times are ahead," one broker said, adding that renewed interest showed in Lemminkainen's rival YIT-Yhtyma earlier this week.
Other Finnish construction stocks were also strong on Thursday.

YIT traded at 65.00 markka, up 1.00, after hitting a new calendar year-high 66.50 markka. Trade was a lively 9.2 million markka. Polar was up 0.28 markka or almost three percent at 7.79 markka, but trade was thin.
